description: This file defines the ImportExportClient class for the AWS SDK, specifically for interacting with the AWS Import/Export service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as createJob, cancelJob, getStatus, etc., and extends the base AwsClient class.

classes.name: ImportExportClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS Import/Export service, providing methods for managing import/export jobs.

methods.name: createJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new import/export job.

methods.name: getShippingLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping label for a job.

methods.name: getShippingLabelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the shipping label for a job.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Fetches the status of an import/export job.

methods.name: getStatusAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the status of an import/export job.
